title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Oh, thank you so much, Doc! Why am I thanking you? Heehee, because you just signed… MY PAID LEAVE APPLICATION!

title: Talk 1
original: I used to be a troublemaker for hire. People PAY for my epic pranks. The coalition government, the Singas, True Bolívar. I don't care who I work for. Sometimes, I even work both sides. I take care of one job on my way to one place, and the other on the way back. Jajaja! All that ruckus, it was glorious!!

title: Talk 2
original: Here, some corn bugles. Want some? No, no! You can't just throw them in your mouth. Where are your manners? Give me your hand, let me show you. First, you put them on each of your fingertips like that, then—Om! Hehe! Thanks for the food!

title: Talk 3
original: You call this a weapon? Hahaha, that's so funny. I call it 'Twirly-twirl.' It's a toy my mama made for me. You can throw it out like this, and then it comes back. What? It's too destructive? That's the fun part.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I've been pretty playful ever since I was a kid. I had enough tricks up my sleeve to turn the tables on the bullies, even pulled a few dukats out of them sometimes. I mean, come on, you need a thrill like that to really feel alive. But here you are, working your butt off all day long. Aren't you bored?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Can't hear the rain in here at all.... You know, Doctor, back when I was a kid, rainy days meant I couldn't go out to play. All I could do was stay in mama's workshop, helping her count screws, and listening to the pitter-patter of rain on the sheetmetal roof... But I don't mind days like that. You surprised?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: A Liberi dude who calls himself a hottie, a Vulpo car mechanic who does things his way, and my fellow Bolívarian with the huge appetite. Just where did you find all these fun people? I knew I made the right choice joining you guys.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Before I left home, I had a huge fight with mama, all because I caught Oripathy. I have my ways to keep from being a burden to my family, but mama… she hugged me so tight, she said she'd sell everything in the house to get me treated. I've never wanted to admit it, but I guess my life really is miserable.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: You know what 'can soccer' is? It's my favorite game! Just take a can out of the ditch or whatever scrap heap, then play ball. Oye wey! What's that look on your face? We may have been poor, but there was plenty of fun to be had. Don't believe me? Come try for yourself!

title: Idle
original: If you're that tired, how about you hand me all your top-secret documents and get some rest?

title: Onboard
original: Caper, or whatever you wanna call me. Just standing here already proves I'm tough enough, right? You're my boss now, so make sure I don't get bored. And be ready for my surprises.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: You saw that move of mine? Hahaha! Their reaction was so funny.

title: Promotion 1
original: All the officers I know are so desperate for promotion, they do all kinds of dirty infighting. So I assumed getting promoted had to be super fun. Hmph, turns out it's no big deal.

title: Promotion 2
original: I guess only my mama would be happy to hear I got promoted... It's all the same to me. But If I get promoted high enough to order you around… Heehee, then my head is full of ideas.

title: Added to Squad
original: Finally giving me a real fun job?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Alright, everyone, don't overdo it! Of course, that doesn't apply to me!

title: Depart
original: Come on, come on! Let's go!

title: Begin Operation
original: Twirly-twirl, it's time to play!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: My turn now?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: What you waiting for? It's gotta be me!

title: Deployment 1
original: Think you can catch me? That's hilarious!

title: Deployment 2
original: What should I play with you guys?

title: In Battle 1
original: Go home to your mama!

title: In Battle 2
original: Watch out—Here comes Twirly-twirl!

title: In Battle 3
original: Watch me cut your pants to scraps!

title: In Battle 4
original: Watch me cut all that hair on your head!

title: 4-star Result
original: That was such a thrill! Can we do it again?

title: 3-star Result
original: The No.1 rule of playing a master prank—is to be a prank master first, haha!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: That's it? I haven't had enough fun.

title: Operation Failure
original: Doctor, you go on ahead! I'm gonna play with them some more!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Doctor? Where did my luggage go? You didn't hide it, did you? Pff... Hahaha, just messing with you. I ain't got no luggage.

title: Tap
original: Whoa~ Need me to keep what you just did a secret?

title: Trust Tap
original: Try touching my ear. I promise, no surprises... Sike!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Before, I always had dinner with my mamá on this day. She always got off work earlier than usual to make me these big fat tacos filled with meat. It's only on this day of the year that I get to eat so much meat... Hey, don't just listen. Eat up.

title: Greeting
original: Doctor, enough work. Let's play!

title: Birthday
original: Look at you. Is today some kinda special occasion? Hehe, you look so funny when you're disappointed. Alright, here's my gift for you. You can probably figure out what it is, right?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Doctor, I'm outta here tomorrow. I really didn't expect to be here for so long, and that I wouldn't ever get tired hanging around you. Rhodes Island's such a fun place. Don't you ever let it get boring. Where am I going next? Haha... A field mission! See ya!
